title: Cabin Overheat and Climate Event Log
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT bridges.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:vehicle inside_temp_c>45
| stats max(inside_temp_c) as peak_temp, count as readings by date_mday
| sort - peak_temp
description: Logs the days your parked car's cabin got dangerously hot, useful if you carry pets, children, or heat-sensitive items.
value: A hot cabin is a real safety issue; a log of peak temperatures shows whether cabin-overheat protection is doing its job.
implementation: Ingest inside-temperature readings; schedule daily and review peak cabin temperatures during summer.
visualization: Column chart of daily peak cabin temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It records the days your car got very hot inside while parked, which matters if you carry pets or children.
